title: Go-Browse: Training Web Agents with Structured Exploration
paper_type_zh: 推理数据、搜索或测试时扩展研究
best_for_zh: 需要核查推理轨迹、反馈契约、发布边界和复用风险的读者
one_line: Go-Browse releases raw and processed WebArena-clone trajectories plus a Qwen checkpoint from graph-frontier task discovery, VLM feasibility judgment, and prefixed/unprefixed browser rollouts.
Go-Browse 通过图前沿式任务发现、视觉语言模型可行性判定与带前缀及不带前缀的浏览器采样，发布 WebArena 克隆环境的原始与处理后轨迹以及一个 Qwen 检查点。
why: It connects task sourcing, search-state reuse, environment interaction, judge-based filtering, and supervised agent training while leaving material release-rights and reproducibility gaps visible.
inclusion_reason: Go-Browse exposes a graph-frontier recipe, judgment-filtered browser rollouts, raw and processed releases, and an SFT checkpoint for studying how interactive environments become agent-training data.

title: Problem
问题
html: The official ICLR 2026 paper and arXiv v2 address a data-collection problem rather than a new browser benchmark: web agents need environment-specific demonstrations, yet human traces are costly and independent unsupervised exploration episodes repeatedly visit easy pages. Go-Browse therefore treats a website as an incrementally discovered URL graph and collects tasks and ReAct browser episodes while reusing paths to previously found pages. The resulting Go-Browse-WA object is not just a list of successful answers: the paper reports 26,749 trajectories over 3,422 tasks and 196,462 interaction steps from 100 URLs in five self-hosted WebArena clone domains, with successful and failed episodes, thoughts, browser actions, observations, rewards, graph/page metadata, and—in the raw release—screenshots, HTML-derived data, and full accessibility trees. This makes the work relevant both to rollout/search trace curation and to environment/agent trajectory data; L4 review should judge the released fields, feedback contract, rights, and reproducibility boundary, not the reported benchmark score alone.

ICLR 2026 官方论文和 arXiv v2 处理的是数据收集问题，而不是提出新的浏览器 benchmark：Web 智能体需要与目标环境相关的示范，但人工轨迹成本高，彼此独立的无监督探索 episode 又会反复访问容易到达的页面。Go-Browse 因此把网站表示为逐步发现的 URL 图，在复用已发现页面路径的同时收集任务和 ReAct 浏览器 episode。Go-Browse-WA 的数据对象不只是成功答案列表：论文报告从五个自托管 WebArena 克隆域的 100 个 URL 中得到 3,422 个任务、26,749 条轨迹和 196,462 个交互步骤，包含成功与失败 episode、thought、浏览器 action、observation、reward、图与页面元数据；原始发布还含截图、HTML 派生数据和完整 accessibility tree。它同时适合“Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data”与“Environment and Agent Trajectory Data”分类；L4 审核应关注实际发布字段、反馈契约、权利与复现边界，而不能只看 benchmark 成绩。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: Go-Browse combines a global reset-and-explore loop with local instruction-first collection. Its outer loop maintains a frontier of discovered but not fully explored URLs and stores trajectory edges, so a later episode can reset to a useful page instead of rediscovering it from the root. At each frontier node, NavExplorer interactively proposes navigation tasks, PageExplorer proposes local tasks, FeasibilityChecker lets Claude-3.7-Sonnet attempt each task and asks a GPT-4o VLM judge whether the attempt succeeded, and cheaper Solvers then sample two prefixed and two unprefixed trajectories. The primary feedback object is therefore a judgment-filtered environment episode: a binary success decision is used for feasibility and dataset inclusion, while WebArena task-specific rewards are used only for benchmark evaluation. Compared with NNetNav-style interaction-first episodes, the graph retains cross-episode navigation knowledge; compared with ordinary instruction-first collection, task proposal occurs at many dynamically reached pages rather than only a root observation.

Go-Browse 把全局的 reset-and-explore 循环与局部 instruction-first 收集结合起来。外循环维护“已发现但尚未充分探索”的 URL 前沿，并把轨迹保存为图边，因此后续 episode 可以重置到有用页面，而不必每次从根页面重新发现。对每个前沿节点，NavExplorer 通过交互提出导航任务，PageExplorer 提出局部任务，FeasibilityChecker 让 Claude-3.7-Sonnet 尝试任务并由 GPT-4o VLM judge 判断是否成功，随后成本较低的 Solvers 分别采样两条带前缀和两条不带前缀的轨迹。因此核心反馈对象是经 judge 筛选的环境 episode：二元成功判断用于可行性判定和数据纳入，WebArena 的 task-specific reward 只用于 benchmark 评估。相较 NNetNav 式 interaction-first episode，URL 图保留了跨 episode 的导航知识；相较普通 instruction-first 收集，任务是在多个动态到达页面上提出，而不是只依赖根页面的静态观察。

title: Method
方法
html: Data collection runs on BrowserGym over five WebArena clones—Shopping Admin, Shopping, Reddit, GitLab, and Map—with 20 URLs explored per domain. Claude-3.7-Sonnet runs NavExplorer for at most 15 steps; PageExplorer uses GPT-4o for at most 20 steps and Claude-3.7-Sonnet for at most 10. Each proposed task receives up to three 10-step Claude feasibility attempts; a GPT-4o VLM-as-a-judge determines success, and at most 30 feasible tasks are retained per URL. For each feasible task, GPT-4o-mini and Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct Solvers produce two trajectories starting at the current page and two starting at the website root, all with a 10-step horizon and temperature 0.7. The raw exporter preserves graph, node, trajectory, per-step action/thought/observation metadata and PNG screenshots; the processed exporter converts trajectories to step-level prompt/completion records linked by next_step_idx, with reward, length, and step number. The paper trains Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct by SFT only on successful trajectories and evaluates at temperature 0 with WebArena task-specific reward functions. Reproduction requires a working BrowserGym/WebArena deployment, model/API access, filled path and credential placeholders in the repository, and a pinned dataset/repository revision; the README provides commands but no turnkey immutable run manifest.

数据收集通过 BrowserGym 运行在五个 WebArena 克隆环境上：Shopping Admin、Shopping、Reddit、GitLab 和 Map，每个域探索 20 个 URL。NavExplorer 使用 Claude-3.7-Sonnet，最多交互 15 步；PageExplorer 分别使用 GPT-4o（最多 20 步）和 Claude-3.7-Sonnet（最多 10 步）。每个候选任务最多进行三次、每次不超过 10 步的 Claude 可行性尝试，由 GPT-4o VLM-as-a-judge 判断成功与否，每个 URL 最多保留 30 个可行任务。对每个可行任务，GPT-4o-mini 和 Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct Solvers 共生成两条从当前页面开始的轨迹和两条从网站根页面开始的轨迹；最大 horizon 均为 10，temperature 为 0.7。raw exporter 保留图、节点、轨迹、逐步 action/thought/observation 元数据和 PNG 截图；processed exporter 将轨迹转换为由 next_step_idx 连接的逐步 prompt/completion 记录，并保留 reward、长度和 step number。论文仅用成功轨迹对 Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct 做 SFT，并在 temperature 0 下用 WebArena task-specific reward function 评估。复现还需要可运行的 BrowserGym/WebArena、模型或 API 权限、补齐仓库中的路径与凭据占位符，并固定数据集和代码 revision；README 提供命令，但没有可直接复放的不可变运行清单。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Table 1 reports 9,504 successful and 17,245 unsuccessful trajectories, totaling 26,749 trajectories and 196,462 steps; the successful/failure step counts are 39,339 and 157,123. The current raw Hugging Face train split independently exposes 196,462 rows, while the processed split exposes 164,533 step records, so those two releases must not be described as the same row set. The paper evaluates the successful-only SFT model on 812 WebArena tasks and reports 21.7% overall success versus 8.3% for the base Qwen model and 18.8% for the matched NNetNav-7B comparison; on the 300-task Online-Mind2Web evaluation, Go-Browse-7B scores 5.33%. These results support that the collection can train the evaluated agent under the reported setup, but they do not prove that every task, VLM judgment, trajectory, screenshot, or released row is correct or reusable. The official repository and Hugging Face pages verify that code, raw and processed datasets, and a Qwen checkpoint exist; they do not provide a full dataset license, provenance/privacy audit, checksumed manifest, or exhaustive mapping from the paper table to the mutable Hub revisions.

论文表 1 报告 9,504 条成功轨迹和 17,245 条失败轨迹，共 26,749 条轨迹、196,462 个步骤；成功与失败步骤分别为 39,339 和 157,123。当前 Hugging Face raw train split 也展示 196,462 行，而 processed split 展示 164,533 条逐步记录，因此不能把两种发布写成同一个行集合。论文在 812 个 WebArena 任务上评估只用成功轨迹做 SFT 的模型，报告总体成功率 21.7%，对照的基础 Qwen 为 8.3%，同设置 NNetNav-7B 为 18.8%；在 300 个任务的 Online-Mind2Web 评估上，Go-Browse-7B 为 5.33%。这些结果说明该集合能在论文设置下用于训练所评估的智能体，但不能证明每个任务、VLM 判断、轨迹、截图或发布行都正确且可复用。官方仓库与 Hugging Face 页面可核验 code、raw/processed dataset 和 Qwen checkpoint 确实存在；它们没有给出完整的数据许可证、来源与隐私审计、带 checksum 的 manifest，或论文表格与可变 Hub revision 之间的穷尽映射。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The nearest data-collection baselines divide into interaction-first methods such as NNetNav, whose exploration episodes do not share state, and instruction-first methods, which propose tasks from a limited observation before solving them. Go-Browse changes the collection substrate by retaining discovered URLs and shortest trajectory prefixes in a graph, resetting exploration to frontier pages, and separating global navigation discovery from local task execution. It also turns task proposal into an interactive agent behavior and explicitly collects both prefixed and root-start solver rollouts after VLM-based feasibility filtering. For this atlas, the direction signal is the coupled record of search state, proposed tasks, judgment, environment actions, and downstream training—not the claim that graph exploration alone guarantees high-quality data. Resetting to known pages resembles Go-Explore and VLM filtering is established practice; the reusable novelty lies in their web-data pipeline composition. A reuse audit should still verify exact prompt versions, graph/prefix fields, negative trajectories, Hub revisions, rights, and whether closed-model judgments can be reproduced.

最接近的数据收集基线可分为两类：NNetNav 等 interaction-first 方法的探索 episode 不共享状态；instruction-first 方法则先从有限观察提出任务，再尝试求解。Go-Browse 的变化在于把已发现 URL 与最短轨迹前缀保存在图中，把探索重置到前沿页面，并将全局导航发现与局部任务执行拆开。它还把任务提出本身变成智能体交互行为，并在 VLM 可行性筛选后显式收集带前缀和从根页面开始的 solver rollout。对本图谱而言，方向信号来自 search state、候选任务、judge、环境 action 与下游训练的联结记录，而不是“图搜索天然保证高质量数据”这一说法。重置到已知页面与 Go-Explore 相近，VLM 筛选也不是全新技术；可复用的新意在于它们被组合为一条 Web 数据流水线。复用审计仍需核对准确 prompt 版本、图与前缀字段、负轨迹、Hub revision、数据权利，以及 closed-model 判断能否重现。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The collection is bounded to five self-hosted WebArena clone domains, so page structure, authentication, mutable state, and task distribution may not transfer to live sites; the Online-Mind2Web analysis shows that NNetNav-7B can outperform Go-Browse-7B on truly out-of-distribution tasks. Feasibility depends on Claude-3.7-Sonnet attempts and a GPT-4o screenshot judge, making false positives, false negatives, prompt sensitivity, model bias, API drift, and unavailable closed weights part of the data lineage. Prefixed trajectories ease local execution by bypassing part of navigation, while successful-only SFT leaves the released failure signal unused. The paper conclusion says “39K unsuccessful task solving trajectories,” conflicting with Table 1's 17,245 unsuccessful trajectories and 157,123 unsuccessful steps; Table 1 and the release schema should govern quantitative use. The processed Hub split has fewer rows than the raw split, repository scripts retain user-filled path/API placeholders, and no versioned manifest, checksum, seed ledger, decontamination statement, dataset/model license, source-content rights statement, or privacy review is disclosed. Benchmark improvements are not evidence that the records or judge labels are uniformly high quality.

数据收集只覆盖五个自托管 WebArena 克隆域，因此页面结构、认证方式、可变状态和任务分布未必能迁移到真实网站；Online-Mind2Web 分析也显示，在真正 out-of-distribution 的任务上 NNetNav-7B 可能优于 Go-Browse-7B。可行性判定依赖 Claude-3.7-Sonnet 尝试和 GPT-4o 截图 judge，因此 false positive、false negative、prompt 敏感性、模型偏差、API 漂移以及 closed weight 不可得都属于数据 lineage。带前缀轨迹通过绕过部分导航来降低局部执行难度，而 successful-only SFT 没有利用已发布的失败信号。论文结论写有“39K unsuccessful task solving trajectories”，与表 1 的 17,245 条失败轨迹和 157,123 个失败步骤冲突；量化使用应以表 1 和发布 schema 为准。processed Hub split 的行数少于 raw split，仓库脚本仍需用户补充路径/API 占位符，同时没有披露 versioned manifest、checksum、seed ledger、去污染说明、dataset/model 许可证、来源内容权利说明或隐私审查。Benchmark 提升不能证明记录或 judge 标签整体具有高质量。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data, Go-Browse is useful as a design and audit case for multi-attempt browser collection: a reusable record can preserve the URL frontier, graph edge/prefix, task proposal, each feasibility attempt, judge output, prefixed versus unprefixed start state, solver identity, step observations/actions/errors, reward, and acceptance outcome. For Environment and Agent Trajectory Data, the raw release provides state-action episodes tied to a concrete BrowserGym/WebArena substrate, while the processed release provides prompt/completion records suited to SFT and the released checkpoint provides a downstream reference. The success/failure trajectories could support future agent-training or verifier studies, but the paper only demonstrates successful-trajectory SFT and evaluation; RL use remains a proposed direction. Before reuse, practitioners should pin revisions, reconcile raw/processed rows, inspect failure and judge records, establish environment resetability and rights, and keep collection-time VLM judgment separate from benchmark task reward.

对“Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data”而言，Go-Browse 可作为多次尝试式浏览器数据收集的设计与审计案例：可复用记录应保留 URL frontier、graph edge/prefix、任务提议、每次 feasibility attempt、judge 输出、prefixed/unprefixed 起始状态、solver 身份、逐步 observation/action/error、reward 与纳入结果。对“Environment and Agent Trajectory Data”而言，raw release 提供绑定 BrowserGym/WebArena 环境的 state-action episode，processed release 提供适合 SFT 的 prompt/completion 记录，已发布 checkpoint 则提供下游参照。成功与失败轨迹未来可用于 agent training 或 verifier 研究，但论文只实证了成功轨迹 SFT 与评估，RL 仍只是作者提出的方向。复用前应固定 revision、核对 raw/processed 行数、检查失败样本与 judge 记录、确认环境可重置性和数据权利，并把收集阶段的 VLM 判断与 benchmark task reward 分开保存。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Distinguish the 196,462-row raw release from the 164,533-row processed release and record which one a claim uses.
  • Preserve task proposal, feasibility attempts, judge outputs, solver traces, graph metadata, observations, actions, and terminal rewards as separate lineage stages.
  • Reconcile the paper's composition table with the separate “39K unsuccessful trajectories” statement before using aggregate counts.
  • VLM feasibility and quality judgments are filtering signals, not proof that every retained task or browser action is correct.
  • Audit page provenance, timestamps, privacy, screenshots, HTML rights, dataset terms, and immutable manifests before reuse.

• 区分 196,462 行的 raw release 与 164,533 行的 processed release，并注明每项结论使用哪一版本。
  • 将任务提议、可行性尝试、judge 输出、solver 轨迹、图元数据、页面观察、动作和终局奖励分别保存为谱系阶段。
  • 使用汇总计数前，应核对论文构成表与另一处“39K 条失败轨迹”表述之间的差异。
  • VLM 的可行性与质量判断只是筛选信号，不能证明每个保留任务或浏览动作都正确。
  • 复用前应审计页面来源、时间戳、隐私、截图与 HTML 权利、数据集条款和不可变清单。

items: GPT-4o VLM judgments can create false acceptance or rejection.

Coverage is limited to five WebArena clone domains and prefixed traces partially bypass navigation.
Successful-only SFT omits the released failure signal.
Mutable web state and absent release manifests limit exact reproduction.
Raw screenshots HTML and accessibility trees lack documented rights and privacy review.
